chapters.title: Chapter 1: First notes
chapters.summary: Eight notes on the top three strings, and the rhythms to play them: quarter, half and whole notes, and rests.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The low strings
chapters.summary: Nine notes on the 4th, 5th and 6th strings, and the ledger lines they sit on.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Three beats and two
chapters.summary: The dotted half note, and bars of three and two beats.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: The whole open position
chapters.summary: Joining low and high, skips, and a tune everyone knows.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Eighth notes
chapters.summary: Two notes to a beat, and the eighth rest.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Key signatures
chapters.summary: F sharp and B flat, the keys of G and F, and their minor keys.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Dots and ties
chapters.summary: Ties, the dotted quarter note, and a waltz.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Accidentals
chapters.summary: Sharps, flats and naturals beside a note, the key of D, and A minor.
